description: This file defines the CalculatorHistory class and related data structures for managing calculation history, including adding, retrieving, and removing history items, as well as maintaining a maximum history size.

classes.name: CalculationManager::CalculatorHistory
classes.description: A class that manages the history of calculations, allowing addition, retrieval, and removal of history items, and enforcing a maximum history size.

methods.name: CalculatorHistory
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the CalculatorHistory with a maximum size.

methods.name: AddToHistory
methods.description: Adds a new calculation result and its tokens and commands to the history.

methods.name: GetHistory
methods.description: Returns the list of all history items.

methods.name: GetHistoryItem
methods.description: Retrieves a specific history item by index.

methods.name: AddItem
methods.description: Adds a history item to the history list.

methods.name: RemoveItem
methods.description: Removes a history item at a specified index.

methods.name: MaxHistorySize
methods.description: Returns the maximum size of the history.
